case.title: Density offers Compact, Regular and Comfortable, Regular by default
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • User {User-B} has the "Admin" role at {Location-A} and has never changed density. You are signed in as {User-B}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST F1 Nora New and {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}, with no lead technician.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices and {Work-order-1} is S1-702.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "List" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Look at the toolbar on the right of the Work Orders page.
  2. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  3. Click the density button.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: List shows no density button.
  • Step 2: Tech View shows, with a density button in its toolbar.
  • Step 3: the menu offers three choices, "Compact", "Regular" and "Comfortable", and "Regular" is marked as in use.

Developers also check this with unit tests: DensityMenu.spec.ts (lines 36 and 57) and WorkOrdersToolbar.spec.ts (lines 207 and 219).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10049 (Story 6, Density in Tech View and Board View)

  • Key decision, Fields vs. density are separate controls: “List has neither new control and stays as it is in production.”
  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View. Board View has no Density control in this release (S3-R11).”
  • S6-R5: “Use Regular as the default density.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

References from Design

Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), Work Orders.dc.html, export of 14 Oct 2026 (design library _ds_bundle.js), read 14 Oct 2026. The design names Tech View's control "Row height", with the choices Small, Medium and Large. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 (design-difference sheet, answer 11) for the PRD's names, Compact, Regular and Comfortable, and this case follows the PRD.

  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), density menu title: “const densTitle = cards ? 'Card size' : 'Row height';”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), Tech View density choices: “const ROW_DENSITY = [['small', 'Small'], ['medium', 'Medium'], ['large', 'Large']];”

changes.new_value:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. A brand-new user who has never changed density (e.g. "Nora New", Admin role, Settings > Staff), signed in in a second browser.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • Leave Lead Technician empty.
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.

changes.new_value:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] with no lead (it sits in Unassigned).
  • [User-B]: a brand-new user who has never changed density (Admin role), signed in in a second browser.
  • Names are examples; what must hold: [User-B] has never changed density.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Leave Lead Technician empty.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): no lead.
  5. A brand-new user who has never changed density (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Nora New", Admin role, Settings > Staff): New Staff Member with an email you can open, Role Admin, at least one Department (required), this location in Location > Save & Close; accept the invitation and set a password. Record this user as [User-B] and sign in as [User-B] in a second browser.
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices" shows [WO-1] in Unassigned; [User-B] can sign in and has not opened Tech View or Board View yet. If [User-B] has changed density, create another new user.

  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] with no lead (it sits in Unassigned).
  • [User-B]: a brand-new user who has never changed density (Admin role), signed in in a second browser.
  • Names are examples; what must hold: [User-B] has never changed density.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Leave Lead Technician empty.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): no lead.
  5. A brand-new user who has never changed density (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Nora New", Admin role, Settings > Staff): New Staff Member with an email you can open, Role Admin, at least one Department (required), this location in Location > Save & Close; accept the invitation and set a password. Record this user as [User-B] and sign in as [User-B] in a second browser.
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Density Choices" shows [WO-1] in Unassigned; [User-B] can sign in and has not opened Tech View or Board View yet. If [User-B] has changed density, create another new user.
